claims.statement: The editor window is composed by EditorWorkspace as a 48px TopHeader row, a flexible studio, a 32px BottomStatusBar and one overlay layer; the studio holds the 48px ActivityRail, an optional ActivityDrawer, and a horizontal resizable pair of centre stage and RightInspector, so no permanent outline column or bottom console drawer exists in this shell.
48px rail四tab为topology/diagnostics/drift/copilot，诊断计数和pending patch dot由相应状态投影，不再simulation。

Toggling the diagnostics rail tab is the one exception among the four: it closes any open drawer and toggles the problems strip under the canvas instead, because a finding is read while looking at the object it names, so one rail button maps to one surface but not always to the drawer.

A single ActivityDrawer shell renders every rail tab, either pinned as a 300px in-flow column or floating as a 320px absolute panel starting at left-12 over the canvas, and the tab content is selected by activeRailTab so switching tabs replaces the drawer rather than stacking another one.
delivery/drift/review 是单一互斥hub，fixed在studio外，第二个替换而非叠加。
review dialog处理Escape/Tab和focus恢复；Delivery/Drift自身仅关闭按钮，无同样键盘trap。

The review hub takes one previewReview snapshot of the live document on mount and marks it stale when the input revision moves, and its per-finding actions either locate the issue on the canvas (disabled when stale, busy or unlocatable) or hand it to the copilot, which closes the hub, opens the copilot drawer, focuses the issue and prefills the composer through a token-stamped prompt.

Whether the split stage is open is derived from the view mode (mode === 'split') rather than stored as a second boolean, and closeSplit returns the mode to graph while keeping the chosen pane, so the segmented control and the visible column cannot disagree.
SecondaryStage只挂active pane，切tab销毁local state；旧simulation pane已移除，不再自动请求replay。
graph/table/split三模式，split四pane为ledger/openapi/cel/drift，接口/rule badges来自当前投影/文档。

Panel geometry persistence is delegated to react-resizable-panels autoSaveId keys (evidence-studio-horizontal-v2 and evidence-stage-split-<direction>-v1); useWorkspaceSplitState's splitSize is only read as defaultSize and never written back from a drag.

CHORDS in commandRegistry.ts is the single source of the key caps the command palette prints, always rendered as ⌘ even though the handlers accept metaKey or ctrlKey, because the desktop shell ships for macOS first; the rail tooltips print ⌘1..4 from RAIL_TAB_CHORDS and the HUD prints ⌘0 and ⇧1 as literals.
rail用Mod digits、view用Alt digits/event.code、V避输入；split映射也含Alt3/4，实际仲裁尊重defaultPrevented，不能只凭显示表断言无冲突。

useEditorShortcuts returns immediately when the keydown event is already defaultPrevented, implementing the rule that a surface which consumed a key owns it instead of having the workspace act on it as well.

Within the editor's keydown handler a pending agent patch outranks everything else on Escape and Mod+Enter: revertPatch is checked before the typing guard so a patch can be taken back from a focused field, acceptPatch on Mod+Enter is checked after that guard so it never steals a textarea newline, and both handlers are spread into the table only while a patch review exists.

Below the pending patch, Escape closes the split stage before it clears the canvas selection, and only an Escape that no surface claimed reaches clearSelection; the closeSplit handler is bound only while split.isSplit so a single-surface workspace keeps selection clearing on Escape.

Two surfaces claim Escape in the capture phase with stopPropagation so the window-level editor handler never runs: the key-data ledger sheet always closes itself, and the inline copilot closes itself only while no agent patch is pending, so a pending patch still reverts.

Navigation of the single workspace selection is split into three mechanisms: the bilateralSync focus bus carrying token-stamped focus-entity/focus-rule intents between panes, shell focus/zoom request tokens that make the canvas pan to a node, and a view-mode effect that re-issues a focus request for the current selection when the stage changes away from the ledger.

The shell is the only place that resolves navigation intent: focusIssue treats an entity#attribute target as select-the-attribute-row plus pan while a Context or relationship target only pans to its geometry without inventing a selection, and focusFromPane ignores the canvas's own announcement, refuses ids the layout does not contain and drops a scope that would hide the target.
drawer定位后unpinned关闭、pinned保留；search以token开后聚焦，诊断定位与problem active issue协作。

The command palette is an index over existing behaviour: buildCommands is a pure function of CommandCapabilities and the same handlers the chord table and header call, disabled rows remain with an explanatory reason, object targets appear only once the query is non-empty, and a chosen row closes the palette before performing its action so a native save dialog is not left behind a focus trap.

The floating HUD is a workspace control island, not a canvas one: the canvas supplies only viewport math and positions the strip at the bottom centre, and CanvasFloatingHud adds card density, view mode, split target and paper while deliberately offering no object-creation action, because creation must honour Context and role bindings owned by the inspector and the agent.

EditorScreen replaces the entire workspace with a message screen when the project path is missing or projects.open fails, and renders a role=alert strip between the header and the studio while live model sync is failing, rather than letting either failure hide inside the studio.

The wide key-data ledger is a modal ui-kit Sheet opened from inside the inspector, and Alt+L opens it only while an entity is selected, which is why the inspector binds that chord rather than the workspace shortcut table.
